verdict.rationale: Gide's own Intellectual Property page describes IP litigation. It names venues: arguing cases before the Unified Patent Court in French and English, and trade mark and design disputes before all French and EU IP courts and offices. It also claims top-tier cross-border patent and trademark litigation. However, it describes no case outcomes or named matters, and trade secrets appear only in the advisory scope, not as litigated disputes. missing for 10: documented litigation outcomes or named cases, evidence of trade-secret litigation specifically, independent corroboration of litigation track record.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: Our teams are well-equipped to argue cases before the Unified Patent Court, with the ability to plead in both French and English.
We also have some of the most in-depth expertise in France for trade mark and design disputes before all the intellectual property courts and offices in France and the European Union.
We have developed top-tier expertise in intellectual property litigation, including in cross-border patent and trademark cases.
